newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X soars on Placer offer.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X soars on Placer offer.

text.p: Shares in Bre-X Minerals Ltd soared on Tuesday after gold miner Placer Dome Inc said it wanted to merge with Bre-X.
Bre-X rose 2.20 to 23.65 on the news in early trading in Toronto on volume of almost 800,000 shares.

Placer Dome proposed a stock-for-stock "merger of equals" at a "significant" premium to Bre-X's current share price. But the offer did not give details about how many shares Placer would offer for each Bre-X share.
"It's another trial balloon coming out of the Placer camp," Maison Placements gold analyst John Ing said.
Ing said a successful bid from Placer depended on Bre-X's obtaining contracts of work and resolving outstanding ownership issues.
"There are so many loopholes," he said. "They are serious, but it's subject to so many subjects."
Placer fell 0.50 to 28.50 in light volume in Toronto and was down 3/8 to 21-1/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
Bre-X is currently considering a joint venture proposal from Toronto-based Barrick Gold Corp. Barrick fell 0.85 to 35.55 in Toronto and by 5/8 to 26-3/8 in New York.
